structured_output.summary:
Stopped before the migration and scheduler work because the task needs `airflow-core/src/airflow/models/backfill.py`, which isn't on the editable list. The only edits so far are the `DagSchedulingState` enum in `utils/state.py` and its test in `test_state.py`. I haven't run any tests, because `aih check` isn't configured for builds and I haven't run the test file.

The spec requires migration 0134 to add an index on `backfill (dag_id, completed_at)`. The `Backfill` model in `models/backfill.py` has no `__table_args__` and no index on that table, so it needs `Index("idx_backfill_dag_id_completed_at", dag_id, completed_at)` (the repo naming convention gives `idx_<columns>`). Without that edit, the ORM metadata and the migration disagree, and the migration-versus-model consistency check fails.

Declaring the index from `models/dag.py` would only work by reaching into the Backfill table from the wrong file. I don't want to do that without a go-ahead.

Please add `airflow-core/src/airflow/models/backfill.py` to the editable files and re-plan. I'd keep T1 otherwise as planned.
